items.title: Becoming the story: Injured journalists battle to leave Gaza for treatment
items.description: Gaza journalists injured or battling illness during the war are demanding urgent medical evacuation abroad.

items.title: Polish Drone Guides Ukrainian Strike on Russian Ammo Depot
items.description: A Polish-manufactured FlyEye reconnaissance drone was utilized by Ukraine’s 26th Separate Artillery Brigade to identify and destroy a Russian ammunition storage facility in the Bakhmut sector. The drone guided a HIMARS missile strike, resulting in a secondary detonation that destroyed the weapons stockpile and an adjac…

items.title: My life as a Russian exile in Paris: 'Becoming a customer of a French bank when you come from Moscow is a real feat'
items.description: 'A Russian in Paris' (4/6). Journalist Elizaveta Osetinskaya, who has taken refuge in France since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, recounts her difficulties opening a bank account as French banks are required to enforce financial sanctions against friends and relatives of the Kremlin.

items.title: Kazakhstan's president urges Putin to ‘freeze’ war in Ukraine
items.description: Kazakhstan's president on Saturday urged Russian leader Vladimir Putin to end the war in Ukraine during talks in the Siberian city of Omsk. Hours earlier, Ukrainian drones struck an oil refinery in Siberia in one of Kyiv's deepest attacks inside Russia.

items.title: Zelenskyy Says Russia Wants To Bring More North Korean Troops Into Ukraine War
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Moscow wants to bring in thousands of North Korean soldiers again for its invasion of Ukraine, with preparations in Russia having been under way since early summer.

items.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
items.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

items.title: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
items.description: Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the elections to be boycotted.

items.title: Middle East: UN warns against wider escalation after Houthi attacks in the Red Sea
items.description: As fighting intensifies in the Middle East, the United Nations on Friday warned against further escalation in the US-Iran war and the risks to global shipping amid the fight over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: How the Houthis blockade of the Red Sea could affect the global economy
items.description: NPR's A Martínez asks former U.S. deputy national security adviser Jon Finer what the blockade of the Red Sea by Houthi rebels means for the global economy.

items.title: Rubio Says U.S. Remains Committed to Ukraine Peace Talks After Meeting With Lavrov
items.description: Rubio said President Donald Trump had made clear that the United States was prepared to help facilitate an end to a "senseless war" if the opportunity arose.
